chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch 551 – Han Li Meets a Ninth-Grade Gale Beast: Death’s Door & A Strange Invitation
chapter_meta_description: Han Li is cornered by a ninth-grade demon beast. After realizing escape is impossible, he prepares to self-destruct—only to receive an unexpected offer.
og_description: Cornered by a ninth-grade demon beast, Han Li is forced to accept a bizarre invitation.
twitter_title: Han Li vs a Ninth-Grade Gale Beast
twitter_description: Cornered by a ninth-grade demon beast, Han Li prepares to detonate his last resort—but the predator has a surprise in store.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-grade demon beast known for its incredible speed, existing on the border between sea beast and demon bird. A ninth-grade Gale Beast can move at near-teleportation speed.
A spirit herb that often grows near high-grade demon beast lairs, used in certain alchemical recipes aimed at demonic or beast-type cultivation.
A major milestone in a demon beast’s journey to humanoid form; completing this stage corresponds to entering the ninth grade, granting near-perfect human appearance.
A dangerous treasure pearl that, when detonated via divine lightning, can unleash a devastating explosion intended as a self-destruction or mutual-kill trump card.
